apps.name: BLE Presence Guard
apps.description: Watches for your phone via BLE while printing. Alerts if you wander too far and leave the print unattended.
apps.author: BambuHelper

apps.name: Crosshair
apps.description: Animated targeting crosshair shown during toolhead homing. Exits when printer is idle.
apps.author: BambuHelper

apps.name: Layer Photo Trigger
apps.description: Shows current layer; flashes when layer changes (syncs with the Expo camera app).
apps.author: BambuHelper

apps.name: Layer Timeline
apps.description: Bar chart of print speed per layer segment. Reveals slowdowns and layer shifts.
apps.author: BambuHelper

apps.name: Mission Control
apps.description: Animated printer status: state-appropriate animation for every print phase.
apps.author: BambuHelper

apps.name: Print Report
apps.description: Shows the last completed print report: job name, duration, layers, temps.
apps.author: BambuHelper

apps.name: Tilt Gallery
apps.description: Swipe through 5 print stat cards by tilting the device left/right. Tap to go back to overview.
apps.author: BambuHelper
